description: In every nonempty model of \(Q\), the chosen proof formula at the numerals for fixed natural numbers \(m,n\) holds exactly when the external proof checker accepts \((m,n)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.proofFormula_numerals
  {T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Theory}
  (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.ProofRepresentation T) (M : Type)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [Nonempty M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q] (p n : ℕ) :
  (P.formula.Realize fun i =>
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.proofTuple p n i)) ↔
    P.check p n = true
